responsibility: This file implements the out-of-line algorithms for GCC’s fixed-universe sparse integer set representation. It allocates and initializes sparsesets, supports deletion during iteration, copying, intersection, set difference, union, and equality testing using the dense/sparse array representation from sparseset.h, and preserves the iterator semantics needed by EXECUTE_IF_SET_IN_SPARSESET users. Its responsibility is efficient sparse-set algebra over integer elements, distinct from bitmap-based dense sets.
same_name_distinction: This implementation file supplies the non-inline sparse-set operations declared by gcc/sparseset.h, such as allocation, deletion during iteration, copying, intersection, difference, union, and equality testing over the dense/sparse representation. In contrast, gcc/sparseset.h defines the sparseset layout plus the inline membership, insertion, pop, clear, and iteration primitives/macros.
